prelaunch_updates.text: OPEN CAMPAIGN: @quipnetwork confirms Quest and Mindshare campaigns end Mon 11/2 at 13:00 UTC (7:00 AM CT) with the final points distribution. Also official: Quip account creation fee waived again through Sun 11/8, and 4,000 sponsored Quantum Echoes reveals refill Sun 11/1. No QUIP token yet; any QUIP token today is a scam.
Teneo (radar only) replied that more information on its TGE is coming soon. No date, tokenomics or token address yet; any Teneo token today is unconfirmed.

OPEN CAMPAIGN: GEN airdrop registration closes this Saturday, Oct 31 (time not given). Only official link: airdrop.genlayer.com. TGE still undated; any GEN token before an official token address is a scam.
Flop Labs: Devnet join instructions by early next week. Arthur Hayes says the public Devnet opens within days and does not count toward any airdrop. No FLOP token exists; any FLOP is a scam.

Final stretch to mainnet: accounts, swaps, points, compute subnets and QVM are live on testnet; one step left, an external chain audit. Discord AMA Thu 10/29 morning US time. OPEN CAMPAIGN repeat: Quip Points open, no end date. No QUIP token or TGE date yet.

Dataline names its token DAT. The DAT auction runs on Uniswap as a CCA (set a budget and a max price; it runs for several days). Start date, FDV and vesting not posted yet. Any DAT token before an official token address is a scam.
Scam alert: people impersonating the TermiX team are asking for investments. TermiX says it runs no community fundraising of any kind. No TMT token or sale exists yet.

GenLayer explains GEN staking: validators must lock GEN to sit on a case, juries grow on appeal, and cheaters lose part of their stake. TGE still undated. OPEN CAMPAIGN: airdrop registration (reopened Tue 10/27) still has no closing date; only link airdrop.genlayer.com.
OPEN CAMPAIGN repeat: Quip Points still open at points.quip.network (no end date). Telegram and YouTube quests (25 points each) are left. No QUIP token or TGE date yet; any QUIP token is a scam.
